::: {#exr-irls-step}

#### One IRLS step for the six-patient trial

In the [six-patient trial](#exm-logistic-regression), start from $\vcoef^* = \vzero$.

1.  Find the fitted probabilities, the weights and the working responses.
2.  Compute $\tp{X} W X$ and $\tp{X} W \vecf{z}$.
3.  Compute the updated coefficients $\inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} W \vecf{z}$.

:::
